analysis_status: POST-HOC numerical sensitivity supplement; no modification of regulatory-prediction-v1 or its raw exact-rank endpoint.
motivation: Primary predictions/errors/controls agree, but exact-rank secondary metrics can differ when source means or predicted values separated by ULPs change ties. Quantums are fixed before running this supplement.
quantized_quantity: Predicted reporter-expression effect only, after native implementation row/position reduction. Do not quantize observed coefficients, refit models, change features or tune levels.
rounding: Nearest integer with ties to even on EXACT Fraction.from_float(saved_prediction)/Fraction(decimal_quantum). Rank the resulting integer codes directly; no convert-back-to-float grid arithmetic.
observed_rows: Exact original source CSV decimal values; they must correspond to saved observed floats and all matchedIDs.
observed_positions: Exact Fraction sum of original source CSV decimal effects divided by number of available alleles; rank those fractions directly.
predicted_rows: Use saved f64 prediction values exactly, matched by family/model/assay/accession.

predicted_positions.rust: Use saved native per_position_errors.predicted_mean and validate groupedidentities.
predicted_positions.python: Reconstruct archived reduction: sort alleles by alternate thenaccession; return firstprediction if all identical; otherwise NumPy float64 mean inthatorder. Verifyrawrhos against archived report before diagnosing gridlevels.

metrics.scope: All four frozen evaluation families, six models and every evaluated assay; row and position Spearman correlations separately.
metrics.ranks: Average ranks for exact ties among Fractions/integers/floats as appropriate.
metrics.correlation: Pearson of rank vectors; returnnull if either rankvectorconstant or sample<2.
metrics.compare: Match each pair of implementation vectors and record both correlations, absolute difference, defined/undefined statuses, unique predicted rankcount, range and maximum absolute predictiondelta.
metrics.interpretation: Tolerance is a reporting comparator inheritedfromv1, not scientific significance and not new permissionto declarev1pass.

required_outputs: one row per family/model/assay/resolution/level with matchedIDcounts and bothmetrics/statuses
source-score precision counts and raw predictionagreement diagnostics

restrictions.no_biological_novelty_claim: This is a numericalmethods diagnostic, not a geneticfinding.
restrictions.new_estimand: Each quantized level is a separately labeled coarse-resolution rank estimand, not a repair of raw exactSpearman.

anchor: Existing v1 prediction tolerance1e-7 and observed source coefficientprecision; levels spanfine floating comparisons to0.01 log2 units. Noquantum chosen basedonagreement orbiologicalassociation.
